title: JutsuKeybinds for IceeRamen Evolution
description: Adds fully customizable jutsu keybinds (including mouse buttons) and dynamic HUD key labels for IceeRamen Evolution. Clientside only, no gameplay changes.
body:
JutsuKeybinds for IceeRamen Evolution

A lightweight client-side quality-of-life addon for the IceeRamen Evolution Naruto mod.

This addon lets you bind your combat jutsu slots to any keyboard key or supported mouse button, while automatically updating the combat HUD to display your configured keybinds instead of the default numeric labels.

Features
Fully customizable jutsu hotbar keybinds
Mouse button support (Mouse4, Mouse5, etc.)
Dynamic HUD labels
Live HUD updates when keybinds change
Optional support for keeping the original number keys
Client-side only
Dedicated server compatible
CatServer compatible
No gameplay changes
No balance changes
No networking changes beyond using the original mod's packet flow



Requirements:
Minecraft 1.16.5
Forge 36.2.39
Original IceeRamenEvolution1.14:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iceeramen-naruto-mod

The original mod is required and is not included.
